title: Not what I was looking for
text: Not what I was looking for. Too long; slips on my leather chair, even with slip-guard sheets; looks shabby.  On the other hand, I have donated them to a local charity, maybe they can sell them for a little cash.

product_metadata.title: TALC Non-Slip Sofa Armrest Storage Organizer, Waterproof Couch Recliner Remote Control Holder with 5 Pockets Armchair Caddy for Ipad, Phone, Magazines, TV Remote Control – 2 Packs(Coffee)
features: ● High Quality Material: 3 layer sponge + waterproof sponge + PP high grade towel fabric and a pvc pipe, it is durable, waterproof, anti-slip and soft, easy to clean.
● UNIVERSAL SIZE: 35*13 inches/90*33cm. fits for most couch, recliner and chair arms; With this armrest organizer pouch hanging at your sofa or you can stick it between your mattress and box spring.

● INSTALLATION METHOD: Place the end underneath your couch cushions to secure the armrest organizer in place. If it is too long and you want to adjust it, you can also roll it up and then put it under the seat, it has PVC pipe under cushion to keep in place, no slide and roll off any more.

● FUNCTION : 5 chair pockets that are designed for your Smart phone, Ipad, book, magazines, TV remote control and so on; it is a very convenient storage helper that keeps your electronic accessories organized. It is large enough to adjust the position of the armchair caddy so that they are very conveniently at hand, without interfering with your arm as you rest it on the recliner arm. Not only is it a handy organizer, but the fabric also protects the arms of the recliner.

●100% AFTER-SALE SATISFACTION: return for a full refund if not completely satisfied within three months of purchase. Any question you have, pls feel free to contact us by e-mail and we are always at your service.
